subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The commander abjured his ______to the king.
solution:
The correct answer is __**allegiance**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **noun** is a word that identifies an item, idea, location, or person
 
• The word **allegiance** means support for a ruler, a regime, a conviction, etc.
